closed_findings.closure: Incumbent target must equal min(original target,entry+max holding); incomparable estimates explicitly exit. New entries beyond holding bound reject. Legacy selector now has the same explicit common-deadline wrapper.
closed_findings.finding: Incumbent hold valuation could reference a different/later deadline than the position native target.

closed_findings.closure: Every action including exit/wait/hold now requires execution=decision+configured positive delay. Late retained quote availability is separate from market execution and nonterminal state must be observed by the next decision.
closed_findings.finding: Public action executor did not initially enforce precommitted decision latency for all actions.

limitations: This review does not establish strategy profitability, forecast calibration, prospective availability of supplied inputs, or equivalence of nominal-boundary management to delayed training targets.
scope: bounded independent source review, no additional pytest run or live replay
verified_properties: Direct currency/USD uses bid for profit and ask for loss; inverse USD/currency uses reciprocal ask/bid respectively.
Integer base units and USD notional conversion are fixed using information available at decision.
Rotate closes and opens atomically; any late validation failure returns the unchanged portfolio/cash with no legs.
Executed traded-pair quote must match execution market clock exactly; FX conversion quotes are bounded stale and separately observed.
All arms decide before future execution maps are used; diagnostic branches and feedback do not feed main state.
Matching native management target and predeclared execution-grid constraints are explicit across arms.
Nonzero original target windows require explicit nominal_management_boundary policy; exact_only refuses them and original policy/window remains in candidate evidence.
Side-zero curve values may inform incumbent valuation without becoming directional new entries.
